description: This file defines a Java class 'Planet' representing a planet with properties such as name, icons, image, moons, volume, and surface area. It includes a constructor and getter methods for each property.

classes.name: Planet
classes.description: A data model class representing a planet with various properties relevant to the app.

methods.name: Planet
methods.description: Constructor for initializing a Planet object with name, navigation icon, image, moons, volume, and surface area.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the planet.

methods.name: getNavigationIcon
methods.description: Returns the navigation icon associated with the planet.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Returns the image resource or URL for the planet.

methods.name: getMoons
methods.description: Returns information about the moons of the planet.

methods.name: getVolume
methods.description: Returns the volume of the planet.

methods.name: getSurfaceArea
methods.description: Returns the surface area of the planet.
